fact: The dissertation states Guinea-Bissau has no structured system for recording police data and that procedures are carried out mostly by hand, with frequent loss or inconsistency of information.
title: A Polícia de Ordem Pública da Guiné-Bissau: Desafios na Investigação dos Crimes de Furto e Roubo
publisher: Instituto Superior de Ciências Policiais e Segurança Interna
